account.title: Personal center
account.nicknameHint: 8–16 characters from the supported CJK, Latin and Russian ranges, digits and underscores. No spaces.
account.nicknameInvalid: Use 8–16 supported characters, without spaces, emoji or hyphens.
account.maxLevel: Maximum current level reached. You can keep earning experience.
account.checkInHint: Resets at midnight Beijing time. The first check-in awards 10 XP.
account.experienceUnavailable: Experience is unavailable. Refresh to try again.
account.dashboardHint: Your profile, progress and daily check-in, all in one place.
account.mfaRegenerateWarning: This immediately invalidates all old recovery codes and revokes other sessions, without changing your authenticator. Verify with a current code or one unused recovery code, then save the new codes.
account.mfaRegenerated: New recovery codes generated. Store them securely.
account.mfaNoRecovery: No recovery codes remain. Verify and regenerate them as soon as possible.
account.mfaStatusUnavailable: Security status is unavailable. Refresh again later.
account.mfaVerifyHint: Verify with a current authenticator code or one recovery code. A successful recovery code is consumed. Verification lasts up to five minutes.
account.mfaResultUnknown: The operation outcome is unconfirmed. Refresh security status before continuing. If enrollment or replacement succeeded but recovery codes were not received, verify and regenerate them. Do not repeatedly resubmit.
account.mfaRecentLogin: Enrollment requires a login within the last five minutes. Sign out and sign in again to continue.
account.mfaSecretHint: Scan the QR code with your authenticator, or add a time-based one-time password (TOTP) account manually using this key. Do not share the QR code or key.
account.mfaDisableWarning: Disabling removes two-step protection, invalidates all sessions and recovery codes, and requires signing in again. Confirm with a current code or one recovery code.
account.mfaRotateWarning: Verify your current authenticator first. It remains valid until you confirm a new code; confirmation replaces the old authenticator and recovery codes and revokes other sessions. A recovery code used here is consumed even if you cancel replacement.
account.mfaRotated: Authenticator replaced. Save your new recovery codes.
account.mfaDisabledSuccess: Two-step verification disabled. Please sign in again.
account.mfaLogoutFailed: Two-step verification is disabled, but local sign-out did not complete. Restart the app and sign in again.
account.mfaFactorRejected: The code or recovery code is invalid, or the session expired. Check it and retry; sign in again if it still fails.
account.mfaRecoveryInvalid: Enter one complete 32-character hexadecimal recovery code.
account.mfaQrFallback: You can add the authenticator manually using the setup key.
account.mfaQrFailed: Could not generate the QR code. Add the authenticator manually using the setup key.
account.mfaExpired: Setup has expired. Start again to continue.
account.mfaCodeRejected: The code is invalid or your session expired. Check your authenticator and try again; sign in again if it still fails.
account.mfaRecoveryWarning: These codes are shown only once and each can be used once. Store them securely so you can sign in if you lose your authenticator.
account.mfaRecoverySaved: I have stored my recovery codes securely
account.mfaSummary: Security status is provided by the server.
account.sessionSummary: You are signed in with a DESKTOP session.
account.permissionSummary: Action permissions granted by the server.
account.welcomeHint: One account for your SCNexus experience.
account.localFirst: Local campaigns and custom content remain available without signing in.
account.formHint: Sign in securely with your email to continue.
account.desktopRequired: Account features require the desktop app. Local features remain available.
account.subject: Email
account.challengeAccepted: Code request accepted; delivery is not guaranteed. Check your inbox or request again after the cooldown.
account.invitationRequired: An invitation is currently required. The server rechecks the policy on submission.
account.invitationOptional: Invitation optional; any supplied code must be valid.
account.policyUnavailable: Registration is temporarily unavailable. Reopen the account page later to try again.
account.newPasswordHint: New password: 8–128 characters, including uppercase, lowercase, a digit and an ASCII symbol.
account.mfaRequired: Second-factor verification required. You are not signed in yet.
account.remoteLogoutFailed: Remote revocation failed or could not be confirmed. Local credentials on this device have been cleared.
account.validation.subject: Enter a valid email (3–254 characters).
account.validation.password: Login passwords must be 1–128 characters; new passwords must be 8–128 with uppercase, lowercase, a digit and an ASCII symbol.
account.validation.proof: Enter all six digits, including leading zeros.
account.validation.challenge: Request a non-expired code for the current email.
account.validation.invitationCode: Invitation code: 8–64 letters, numbers, underscores or hyphens; case-sensitive.
account.error.badRequest: Invalid request. Check the inputs, verification code and invitation.
account.error.unauthorized: Invalid credentials or session. Sign in again.
account.error.forbidden: Access denied by the server. Account or verification requirements were not met.
account.error.rateLimited: Too many requests. Try again later; requests are not resent automatically.
account.error.network: Cannot connect to account services. Check your connection.
account.error.invalidResponse: Account service response did not match the contract. Try again later.
account.error.desktop: The account operation could not be completed. Restart the app and try again.
account.error.credentialStorage: Secure credential storage is unavailable or saving failed. No local login was established. Check the system credential service before retrying.
account.error.registrationRejected: The server rejected the submitted information. Check the challenge code, expiry, email, password and invitation. Do not repeatedly resubmit registration.
account.error.notFound: Content was not found or is not visible.
account.error.conflict: State changed or revision conflicts. Reload and confirm your changes.
account.servicesDisabled: SCNexus official services are disabled. Re-enable them in Settings. Local features remain available.
